name: Fluttering Friends
source:
Fluttering Friends is a bird-friending simulator with silly dialogue, adorable art, and fun tunes.  You're a shy little pigeon who's dropped into the city square looking for other birds to friend! Good luck out there!

[From [url=https://saplingstudiogames.itch.io/fluttering-friends]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Fluttering Friends》是一款与鸟儿交朋友的模拟游戏，拥有逗趣的对话、可爱的画面和欢快的音乐。你是一只害羞的小鸽子，刚飞到城市广场，想结识其他鸟儿！祝你好运！

[摘自[url=https://saplingstudiogames.itch.io/fluttering-friends]Itch.io[/url]]
